answer: Tournament bond: each identity locks 70 credits and stakes one token on the basalt bracket board. Each epoch a gale window opens one single-elimination bracket; each match is real work judged on the board, winners split the pool, losers burn their bond. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 onyx tokens plus 50,000 in fees against a 40,000 pool; rented players carry the owner's key, so a second entry burns both. An honest player pays 50 once and keeps the bond.
